messages.author: 5a1b5a9591c118ef
messages.subject: Re: geom_tile with diagional shades
parts:
Hi,

Not really, no (as far as i know). With a little bit of work you could
perhaps write a new geom based on geom_tile but using patternGrob()
from gridExtra,

library(gridExtra)
example(patternGrob)

You'd also have to write a scale_ function to map the pattern to an aesthetic.

HTH,

baptiste
